set.body: Supersede the eight-participant GW-12 pilot for sensitivity claims. Use combined 0-3000 ms recognition paths from every analyzable participant-item pair under a score-blind rule. Preserve a fixed five-candidate held-out item-information estimand, participant/item cross-fitting, candidate-invariant registration, saliency-by-correctness model adjusted for probe type, crossed participant-item uncertainty, fair density/MultiMatch/elastic comparators, and local-only raw/trial outputs. Data-only audit currently supports 1,295 of 1,348 combined-eligible trials from 36 participants; freeze exact folds, candidate rotation, support, exclusions, multiplicity, and runtime policy before scoring.
set.title: GW-13 Run maximal-cohort recognition sensitivity court
